title: Read planning records at a revision
responsibility: Reads stored plans and converts their versions, messages, images and history for the desktop.

inputs.name: planningReads.context
inputs.description: The repository directory and planning API used to load the plan snapshot.

inputs.name: planningReads.revision
inputs.description: The revision whose complete planning snapshot is requested.

inputs.name: planRecord.context
inputs.description: The repository and API used while converting one plan.

inputs.name: planRecord.plan
inputs.description: The stored plan to convert, including its versions, contract, threads and lifecycle.

inputs.name: planRecord.revision
inputs.description: The revision from which to read that plan’s prompt and notes files.

inputs.name: planVersion.context
inputs.description: The repository and API used to read one design version’s text.

inputs.name: planVersion.data
inputs.type: { version: StoredVersion; plan: PlanDetail; revision: string }
inputs.description: The stored version, containing plan and revision; the plan supplies approvals and the version supplies image and option metadata.

inputs.name: readPlanMessages.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to read messages.

inputs.name: readPlanMessages.data
inputs.type: { entityId: string; threadId: string; revision: string }
inputs.description: The entity, thread and revision whose messages are requested.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to read an image.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.query
inputs.description: The entity, version, image hash and revision, plus an optional design option. The image must appear in that entity/version.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to read history.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.entityId
inputs.description: The entity whose planning history is requested.

outputs.name: planningReads
outputs.description: A promise for converted plan records. Any rejected plan in the snapshot causes the whole read to reject with its reported path and reason.

outputs.name: planRecord
outputs.description: A promise for a desktop plan record with plural category, contract, converted versions and threads.

outputs.name: planVersion
outputs.description: Returns the requested design version with prompt/notes, approval, revisions, option metadata and every image exact committed relative filename.

outputs.name: readPlanMessages
outputs.description: A promise for the selected thread’s messages converted to display records.

outputs.name: readPlanImage
outputs.description: A promise for the stored image bytes after the planning API read; the optional design option is passed through.

outputs.name: readPlanHistory
outputs.description: A promise for commit history entries with event-kind summaries and null design-version fields.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects corrupt plan snapshots, missing threads, images absent from the requested entity/version, and underlying planning or Git read failures.
